name: Cefaclor
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 250 mg every 8 hours; doubled for more severe infections (such as pneumonia) or less susceptible organisms

pk.half_life_eskd: 2.3 to 2.8 hours with no kidney function (label)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 60% to 85% unchanged in urine within 8 hours

sources.citation: Azorian Pharma, LLC. (2022). Cefaclor for oral suspension, USP [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, ANDA065412, set ID 224af904-38f3-4210-a750-e21006db4c66, version effective November 1, 2022]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
